content.short: Current gives Sui users isolated lending pools for yield-bearing tokens, one-click looping and margin trading.
content.description: Current is built for people holding yield-bearing tokens on Sui. Its lending market keeps each asset in an isolated risk pool with its parameters visible onchain. The Multiply tool uses flash loans to loop a deposit into a leveraged yield position in a single click. Margin trading against integrated DEX liquidity is available too. The project is backed by the Sui Foundation, with risk managed by Allez Labs. Its focus is tokenized real-world yield, and the protocol has been formally verified and audited by Asymptotic and MoveBit, with insurance cover from Nexus Mutual.
content.meta: Isolated lending pools, one-click yield looping and margin trading for tokenized yield on Sui. Explore Current on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
